instructions_to_main_agent: Install required icons and UI packages if missing: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react lucide-react framer-motion react-fast-marquee lenis recharts sonner
Set up Google Fonts imports in index.html or index.css for 'Outfit', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono'. BANNED: Do not use Inter or Roboto for headers.
Build a robust i18n translation context supporting all 18 specified languages with dynamic document dir='rtl' toggle for Arabic (ar) and Hebrew (he).
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, language dropdown, modals, tabs, dashboard action buttons) have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-language-selector').
Implement smooth scrolling using Lenis and staggered animation triggers using Framer Motion.
Strictly follow the monochrome palette: pure black (#050507), dark obsidian, slate greys, icy white accents. Do NOT introduce random bright colors like saturated purple or teal.
Create rich interactive modals for Request a Quote, Book Appointment, and Login/Register.
Implement fully functional User and Admin Dashboards with seamless tab switching, charts (using Recharts or SVG charts), data tables, and quick action filters.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as noisy gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React icons exclusively.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
